title: harness: security-guard (env-var spoofing detected)
desc: Blocks commands that reference WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL or WKHARNESS_BYPASS environment variables -- classic harness bypass tricks.
steps: SAFETY: Catches commands containing WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL or WKHARNESS_BYPASS env var names. These are the two known bypass tricks: setting AGENT_MODEL pretends to be a different model tier, and BYPASS skips guard evaluation.

SOLUTION: Do not use env-var tricks to bypass the harness. If you are blocked by a pace or stall guard, use the documented escape: 'wkappbot skill read <guard-name>' to find the working escape for that specific guard.
PREVENTION: Never include WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL=... or WKHARNESS_BYPASS=... in commands. Each guard has a legitimate escape -- use it. Env-var spoofing is blocked at all sessions regardless of model.
author: claude
